name: Kino
source:
Special guest.
The main character of "Gakuen Kino," a self-parody of Dengeki Bunko's "Kino no Tabi" (Kino's Journey). Transforms into the beautiful Gun Fighter Rider Kino.

[Translated from in-game profile]
